args.description: The Mr. Evil user profile contains mIRC configuration logs showing brief presence in multiple IRC channels on Undernet and EFnet networks on 2004-08-20. Accessed channels include: (1) #Elite.Hackers (Undernet) session start at 10:45:34, (2) #CyberCafe (Undernet) session 10:54:21-14:02:55 with only 3 minimal messages from mrevilrulez user ("glib marm cuyk" at 10:55, "hi" at 10:57, "." at 11:00), (3) #ISO-WAREZ (EFnet) 10:29:01-10:29:42 (41 second session), and (4) #evilfork (EFnet) 10:30:18 with minimal activity. The mIRC client is configured with primary nick "Mr", alternate nick "mrevilrulez", user identity "Mini Me", email "none@of.ya", and host set to Undernet Los Angeles server (losangeles.ca.us.undernet.org:6660). The pattern shows idle presence in hacking-related IRC channels rather than active substantive participation. Detailed analysis of the #CyberCafe log shows the user was passively in the channel during a 3+ hour period but made only 3 messages - consistent with idle channel presence rather than active engagement or coordination.
